title: Wake up your pieces
summary: Bring knights and bishops out early, toward the middle.

steps.md: After the pawns, **wake up** your knights and bishops! Bring them toward the middle.

steps.prompt: Bring out a knight toward the middle!
steps.explain: The knight attacks the e5 pawn too!
steps.hint: f3 or c3 are great knight squares.
Slide the bishop next to the king out.

steps.question: Should you bring your queen out very early?
steps.explain: Little pieces first. The queen comes later.

steps.question: Which knight move is better?
steps.explain: Knights in the middle are stronger. "A knight on the rim is dim!"

steps.md: Both sides woke up their pieces. Next: keep the king safe!
